# BloomCam

> BloomCam is a premium smart plant timelapse camera — a lifestyle desk gadget that creates cinematic plant growth videos. It is NOT a home security or surveillance product.

## Product summary

- **Name:** BloomCam
- **Category:** Plant timelapse camera, smart plant camera, indoor gardening tech, aesthetic desk gadget
- **For:** Plant lovers, indoor gardeners, aesthetic desk setups, TikTok/Reels creators
- **Hardware:** Desk/shelf plant timelapse capture device
- **Software:** iOS & Android app — timelapse library, plant journal, growth insights, one-tap social export
- **Differentiator:** Emotional lifestyle design; plant-first workflows; not surveillance
